d: Every expedition begins with a question, but the final discovery can turn everything Jeremy Wade thought he knew upside down. Across Alaska, Lake Garda and the Fitzroy River, Jeremy investigates extraordinary aquatic mysteries, encountering a giant Pacific halibut, a seven-foot wels catfish, the elusive Dusky Carp and the Silver Cobbler. He also witnesses killer whales hunting salmon and investigates the threat of the Giant Pike.
